t.description: Hood Mountain Regional Park and Open Space Preserve

t.name: Western Route
t.description: Wide, slowly climbing double track for most of this trail connects you from the Kawana Terrace parking lot in the north to Sky Lupine Trail in the South.

t.name: Sky Lupine Trail
t.description: This newly rebuilt trail in 2021/2022 replaces old Eastern Route trail to Taylor Mountain's summit. It's a much gentler climb to the top, though a bit longer with several long switchbacks & wide turns. Suitable for hikers & mountain bikes both ways.
